the majority of climate change research in primary health care is focused on the health impacts of climate change and that this is a missed opportunity for the primary care sector.

the ways in which climate change and climate change adaptation are being conceptualised in the health field.
the ways that primary health care practitioners could make a bigger difference to the global climate crisis.
how climate change research can better support primary health care practitioners in the UK to make a bigger difference.
